quirc 1.2 -- the QR-code reader

Source:   https://github.com/dlbeer/quirc , tag v1.2, the archive
          https://github.com/dlbeer/quirc/archive/refs/tags/v1.2.tar.gz
          (42,916 bytes), downloaded 2026-11-04 with the author's yes (IM9c).

WHAT IS HERE (7 files): lib/decode.c, lib/identify.c, lib/quirc.c, lib/version_db.c and the two headers
lib/quirc.h and lib/quirc_internal.h, flat, with LICENSE (ISC). Not one file is edited. Not vendored: the demo
programs, the tests, the camera and SDL front ends, the Makefile.
  Built by build.zig addQuirc into stz_image only (needs_quirc), without the UB sanitizer, and called from codes.zig
  through quirc.h (quirc_new, quirc_resize, quirc_begin/end, quirc_extract, quirc_decode, quirc_flip).
  quirc's own limits, said so a reader is not surprised: QUIRC_MAX_REGIONS is its default 254, QUIRC_MAX_CAPSTONES 32 (so QUIRC_MAX_GRIDS 64),
  and it reads QR (not Micro QR) of versions 1 to 40.

The archive's sha256 below is the one COMPUTED on download: GitHub publishes no hash for a tag archive, so it cannot
be compared with an upstream value, and the tree below is the checked-in subset, not the archive.
